_readme: Exceptions for scripts/security/audit-gate.mjs (high/critical advisories in runtime dependencies).
Entry: { "package": "<npm name>", "advisories": ["GHSA-..."] (optional), "reason": "why it is not exploitable in Redstring", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD" }.
Expiry at most 180 days out; an expired entry fails the gate so the exception is re-reviewed.
Prefer fixing: upgrade, replace, or move the package to devDependencies if it never ships.
